Grimmsnarl

Dark Fairy

Galar · Generation 8

Grimmsnarl is a Dark/Fairy-type Bulk Up Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 61 kg. It evolves from Morgrem. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 510.
